newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria'S Assad in phone talks with Egypt's Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Syria'S Assad in phone talks with Egypt's Mubarak.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad phoned Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Wednesday to discuss bilateral issues, his spokesman said.
Joubran Kourieh said the conversation came during the afternoon but gave not further details.
Assad's deputy Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara visited Cairo on Saturday for talks with Mubarak on Syria's stalled peace talks with Israel.
Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa was quoted by regional newspapers as saying contacts between Assad and Mubarak were continuing and the two leaders might meet soon.
Mubarak is to visit the United States soon to discuss with President Bill Clinton how to advance peace in the Middle East, especially the Syrian-Israeli track suspended for about a year.
